import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import mir_eval.display

plt.switch_backend('Agg')
fig, ax = plt.subplots()

intervals_hier = [ref_intervals, ref_intervals]
labels_hier = [ref_labels, ref_labels]

ax_ret = mir_eval.display.hierarchy(
    intervals_hier,
    labels_hier,
    levels=["Coarse", "Fine"],
    ax=ax
)

num_patches = len(ax_ret.patches)
expected_patches = 2 * len(ref_intervals)

assert ax_ret is ax, "Returned axes should be the same as the input axes"
assert num_patches == expected_patches, f"Expected {expected_patches} patches, got {num_patches}"

print(f"__CHECK__ hierarchy {num_patches}")
